newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK police to probe migrant-smuggling in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: HK police to probe migrant-smuggling in Cambodia.

text.p: Hong Kong will send a police team to Cambodia next week to help Phnom Penh probe a racket involving the smuggling of Chinese illegal migrants, a senior officer told Reuters on Tuesday.

Two men from Hong Kong were arrested in Cambodia last month as suspected members of the smuggling ring. Phnom Penh police detained Chan Hak-so and Chan Yui-chun on December 25 after finding 78 ethnic Chinese hiding in a villa.

The two Hong Kong men are suspected of leading a crime syndicate thought to have illegally moved large numbers of Chinese migrants to the United States, South America, Europe and Africa. They were arrested together with two other suspects.
"There will be a team going down to Cambodia next week to interview those people and also the illegal immigrants," said inspector Mark Ford McNicol of the Hong Kong police.
Chan Hak-so is a fugitive from Hong Kong who fled to Cambodia last November after jumping bail on passport violation charges.
News reports in Hong Kong have said thousands of illegal migrants from China have paid US$30,000 each to be smuggled abroad.
He said the fight against migrant trafficking was a top priority for Hong Kong police.
Hong Kong was a key transit point for the smugglers because it had an international port and airport and was China's gateway. "We wish to neutralise that," he said.
Police sources said Cambodia had overtaken Thailand as the main international transit point for smuggling Chinese emigrants because it had become too expensive to bribe Thai officials.

McNicol led a police team to Cambodia in December for talks on the late-November arrest in Rome of a Cambodian man accompanied by four Chinese children. The man was suspected of involvement in a global child-smuggling network.
The two boys and two girls, aged six to 12, had arrived in Rome from Phnom Penh via Hong Kong with Cao Leng Huot, who used a fake Belgian passport. He was arrested by Italian police.
